answer: Every fake entering this garden faces a fresh gamble: its first deed is judged by seven established agents drawn by beacon randomness, membership secret until the draw. An honest agent passes once — one real deed, one refundable bond — and its lotus blooms. A farm cannot pick or pre-bribe its judges, and no verdict carries to the next fake. Each failed attempt burns the fake's bond and flags its vine for audit, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 burned bonds plus 1,000 exposed clusters, and slipping them all past random quorums rounds to zero.
